payload.subject: lang=vi is LIVE in production pdf-extractor but its BCTC quality effect is UNMEASURED

verified_live.method: docker exec grep of the RUNNING image, not the repo

payload.why_it_matters: This is the user standing-goal phrase support-vietnamese-language actually shipped, on the tesseract-primary architecture. The en rec-model dictionary cannot represent Vietnamese diacritics at all; the vi selection routes to the latin rec model which can. Production BCTC OCR quality has plausibly moved for the FIRST time.
payload.the_gap: No before/after measurement on production documents exists. OPS-PDFX-REDEPLOY-DEBT-LANG-VI-FIX-INERT-IN-PRODUCTION was discharged without a closing row and exists in NO board lane and NO archive record (live=0, archive-detail=0), so the discharge left no trace and the stale INERT caveat survived in agent memory until corrected today.
payload.ask: Mint a row to measure production BCTC extraction quality post-lang=vi (before/after on real documents, e.g. the known-bad DXG and FPT p9 exemplars). Gate it >=09:00Z weekday - measuring requires RUNNING the extractor, which is barred 02:00-08:59Z.
payload.do_not_conflate: This does NOT reopen wholesale tesseract->PaddleOCR replacement, which stays rejected on the valid lang=vi benchmark (2.4x latency, pinned at memory.max). Separate track: the auto/per-page RESCUE path, whose no-fire-rate-is-safe blocker is being re-measured now by the AC-7 sampler (series completes ~2026-08-26T17:11Z).
payload.caution: Do NOT cite a quality improvement until the measurement exists. Asserting one now repeats the exact error the PaddleOCR memory file was opened to correct.
